comments.author: Hans
comments.body:
What is the equation for SP or SM versus attack power?
Like +1 SM equals 5 attack power?

comments.author: CRZY_PSYCO_CHICK
comments.body:
Swordplay=+3 attack every rank(affects all melee weapons)
SwordMastery=+1 attack every rank(affects all melee weapons)

Sniping=+4 attack every rank(effects speed of guns and bows)
Gunfire=+0 attack every rank(only affects speed of guns)
(Bows only need sniping)
(Guuns need both sniping and gunfire)

Throwing=+4 attack every rank(affects throwing knives only)

Good luck guys! :D

comments.author: Lena
comments.body:
Att. Power
◾Melee: (Equipment Attack Power + Battle Level + Forte Weapon Attack Bonus + Swordplay * 3 + Sword Mastery * 1) * 0.95~0.99
◾Middle: Equipment Attack Power + Battle Level / 2 + Forte Weapon Attack Bonus + Throwing * 4
◾Range: Equipment Attack Power + Battle Level / 2 + Forte Weapon Attack Bonus + Sniping * 4
Def. Power
◾Melee: First Aid * 3 + Battle Level + Equipment Defense Power
◾Middle: (Swordplay * 2.5 + Battle Level / 2 + Equipment Defense Power) * 0.8
◾Range: (Swordplay * 2.5 + Battle Level / 2 + Equipment Defense Power) * 0.7
Copied and pasted from the Wiki
